race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
race.verdict: CONCERT BOY has a good record in this grade here and may resume winning ways off a quick turnaround. Barleybrown will probably be knocking on the door again, with Haltonwood one of a number who appeal off slipping marks. CONCERT BOY (IRE) BARLEYBROWN HALTONWOOD (IRE)
